review: Fresh independent formal cycle 06 spatial/composition critic

categories.name: Scale, layout and route readability
earned_strengths: Believable relative scale across personnel arch, cargo apparatus, office furniture, doors and covered trolley.
Four corner cutaways show broad main-floor circulation with perimeter-bound equipment and distinct office/support zones.
PLAYER_REVERSE and PLAYER_PINCH retain legible through/return floor areas without a visible critical obstruction.

deductions.finding: At entry, the check-in destination is poorly exposed: the visible office element is its glazing flank, while the hatch lies on a separate front face. Route recognition is good but the administrative stop requires a turn that the fixed entry composition does not guide strongly.

Check-in spur and worker/cart through-routes share the same yellow dashed grammar. The cutaways communicate floor topology, but arrival/administrative/inspection order and lane distinction are less immediate than the basic opening silhouettes.

categories.name: Inspection/check-in hero hierarchy and functional composition
earned_strengths: The bright personnel arch is an immediate inspection landmark with an open human-scale passage.
Cargo case, roller bed, curtain and framed tunnel form a coherent cargo-examination function.
The direct hatch views show a clear, specific administrative service composition rather than anonymous desk dressing.

deductions.finding: Check-in is convincingly focal in C03/DETAIL_CHECKIN/WALL_OFFICE_FRONT but does not visibly co-lead C01/C02/PLAYER_REVERSE. Those movement views favor the personnel scanner and office glazing, so the two principal functions have uneven presence.

In the wide inspection and cargo beauty compositions, the darker cargo shell, supports and nearby barrier compress into a secondary mass. The case and lit curtain opening are clear, while the machine construction is less immediately separated at approach distance.

limitations: This is visual spatial/composition review, not a category 8 geometry/navigation/support-contact certification.
No old scores/reports, builder code, repair plans, HANDOFF or TASK_STATE were read. Native and renderer files were hashed only.
The 99 overall owner threshold cannot be certified by this two-category review. Scores of 96 and 95 do not support treating these categories as 99-quality.
